purpose: v16 layer-streamed GPU KV staging, FP32 predictor, shared embedding

runs.note: V16 layer-streamed GPU KV staging uses two alternating one-layer buffers; pinned CPU staging remains per step. FP32 predictor, selected indices, recent-20, carry and attention match V12. Async predicts and packs the next step during current decode; next-step H2D begins at its decode boundary. dma_ms spans all layer transfers and compute gaps, so it is not pure DMA service time.

interpretation: Prefill, decode and end-to-end are separate. decode_tokens_per_s excludes prefill. Peak GPU allocation and physical pinned CPU/GPU staging are reported separately.

nvml_memory.scope: NVML whole-device used memory, sampled from model loading through warmup and measured runs; includes CUDA context/non-PyTorch allocations. Not an exact instantaneous peak. GPU exclusively assigned; no other process modified.
